titles.native: 黒子のバスケ「ゼロステップ」

description:
A short music video made for the project to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the Kuroko no Basket anime. Directed and storyboarded by Shunsuke Tada, the animation is accompanied by the song Zero Step by GRANRODEO featuring Kenshou Ono.

Note: A ~2-min short version of the music video was uploaded onto YouTube on October 28, 2022. The full version was released in theaters alongside 4D screenings of the "Kuroko no Basket: Last Game" film on January 20, 2023.
